response.sql: WITH funding_metrics AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) FILTER (WHERE s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3) FILTER (WHERE s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT funding_source, avg_y_vs_x_difference, area_to_volume_ratio, area_to_volume_ratio - (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) FROM funding_metrics) AS ratio_above_average FROM funding_metrics WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) FROM funding_metrics) ORDER BY funding_source;
